# Digital Online: Full-Service Digital Agency

> Digital Online is a full-service digital agency providing IT, online store, automation integration, AI, digital marketing, and business consulting services to clients in Romania and the European Union.

Official website: [https://digital-online.ro/en/](https://digital-online.ro/en/)
Other language versions: [Romanian](https://digital-online.ro/llms.txt), [Spanish](https://digital-online.ro/es/llms.txt), [Brazilian Portuguese](https://digital-online.ro/pt-br/llms.txt)

## Main services

- **Websites & IT services**: company websites, updates to existing sites, maintenance, troubleshooting, speed optimization, security, and on-page SEO
  - Page: [IT services](https://digital-online.ro/en/servicii-it.html)
- **Online stores**: custom themes, product uploads, AI image generation, and automated courier and invoicing integrations
  - Page: [Online stores](https://digital-online.ro/en/magazine-online.html)
- **Automated integrations**: SmartBill and Oblio invoicing; Fan Courier, Sameday, Cargus, GLS, and DHL delivery; Stripe, Netopia, and PayU payments
  - Page: [Integrations](https://digital-online.ro/en/integrari.html)
- **Online business consulting**: digital, tax, legal (GDPR), accounting, company setup, and growth strategies
  - Page: [Consulting](https://digital-online.ro/en/consultanta.html)
- **Product imports from China**: Alibaba/1688 supplier sourcing, negotiation, quality control, sea and air freight, customs clearance, EORI, VAT, and GPSR
  - Page: [China imports](https://digital-online.ro/en/import-china.html)
- **Digital advertising & marketing**: Google Ads (Search, Shopping, YouTube, Display), Meta Ads (Facebook, Instagram), TikTok Ads, and LinkedIn Ads
  - Page: [Digital marketing](https://digital-online.ro/en/promovare.html)
- **Video and photo editing**: Reels, TikTok, Shorts, video ads, AI voiceovers, animation, and Instagram carousels
  - Page: [Video and photo editing](https://digital-online.ro/en/montaj-editare-video-foto.html)
- **AI implementation & chatbots**: website chatbots, AI customer service agents, voice AI, AI content generation, and n8n/Make/Zapier automation
  - Page: [AI implementation](https://digital-online.ro/en/implementare-ai.html)
- **Custom platforms & applications**: SaaS, marketplaces, CRM, ERP, LMS, dashboards, and iOS and Android apps
  - Page: [Custom platforms](https://digital-online.ro/en/platforme-custom.html)

## Technologies

- Frontend: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript ES6+
- Frameworks: Shopify Hydrogen, Next.js, React, Vue.js
- Backend: Node.js, Python, PHP
- Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB
- Mobile: React Native, Flutter, Swift, Kotlin
- AI: OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Stable Diffusion
- Automation: n8n, Make, Zapier
- Cloud: AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, Hetzner
